import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tmp/harness.py')
s = p.read_text()
s += '''

_ENGINE = None

def engine_path(rebuild=False):
    """Return the prebuilt engine binary, building it once if needed."""
    global _ENGINE
    if _ENGINE is None or rebuild:
        import pathlib as _pl
        base = _pl.Path('/workspace/submission')
        subprocess.run(['python3', str(base / 'build.py')], check=True,
                       env=dict(os.environ, LD_LIBRARY_PATH='/opt/rust/lib'))
        _ENGINE = str(_pl.Path(os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/workspace/tmp')) / 'unit-merge-build' / 'engine')
    return _ENGINE

def run_request(request):
    """Validate with the real transport, then run the engine binary directly."""
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission_main', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    data = mod.transport(request)
    p = subprocess.run([engine_path()], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p
'''
p.write_text(s)
